limitations: E3 assignments follow the source's lowest-allowed multipolarities; no measured DCO/polarization for these weak E3 branches.
98Mo intensity marginal errors include statistics/fitting only; approximately4% efficiency systematic is separately reported without covariance.
100Ru uses reprinted ratios to E2, so their correlation is unknown. They are not independent new measurements.
Energy uncertainty propagation is illustrative independent-error propagation; shared-level covariance was not supplied.
K=0 strong-coupling mapping is a declared conditional control, not an assignment inferred for these states.
No likelihood, p-value, absolute strength, lifetime, intrinsic shape, or exclusion of a full model family is inferred.
